title: Interior Hessian estimates for k-convex solutions of Hessian quotient equations with 2k>n
summary: We establish interior Hessian estimates for $k$ convex solutions of $\frac{σ_k(D^2u)}{σ_l(D^2u)}=1$, where $1 \leq l n$.The proof combines a concavity inequality with a pointwise doubling argument.
